descricao: Build JavaScript plugins for the CatSuite Android app with SDK completions, validation, local previews, signed packages and custom themes.
confianca: Creation, preview, signing and export require a trusted workspace. Inspection and code assistance remain available.
virtual: Project and package operations require a local or remote filesystem.
idiomaConfiguracao: Panel, prompt and help language. VS Code command labels follow the editor interface language.
validacaoConfiguracao: Validate manifest, JavaScript and workflow while editing.
painelConfiguracao: CatSuite panel style; does not automatically change the global theme.
sugestoesGlobais: Show cat. suggestions and catplug templates in any format, including files outside projects.
